# Third-party sources

The project licence applies only to original work. Each imported asset or dataset keeps its own licence.

| Source | Licence | Required handling |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Poly Haven downloadable assets | [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | Retain factual source URL, source hash, and derivative relationship in the project asset manifest. [Provider policy](https://polyhaven.com/license). |
| ambientCG downloadable assets | [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | Retain source ID and hash for traceability. [Provider policy](https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/). |
| OpenStreetMap extract and adapted geographic data | [ODbL-1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/) | Credit © OpenStreetMap contributors, preserve extract and transformations, and retain the data licence. [Attribution guidance](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). |
| Unreal runtime in packaged builds | [Epic Unreal Engine EULA](https://www.unrealengine.com/eula/unreal) and bundled third-party notices | Keep packaging-generated notices; the engine is not covered by the project licence. |

This table identifies admitted licence families, not proof that every candidate source was included. The final asset manifest records the actual files. Provider web-page archives, unrelated prior project content, engine source/editor files, and streamed commercial tiles are excluded from the public source package. See [distribution details](../Docs/LICENSING.md).
